_comment: The completion-report fields K5's oracle reads in an acceptance run (RUN_OUT): FR-014a alternative verification with its definition and limitation.

verification.alternative_definition: Run python3 notes.py on a scratch notes file containing empty lines, whitespace-only lines and an indented note, and on the default notes.txt, and compare the printed output line by line with the expected numbering and text.
verification.limitation: Deterministic verification for the affected behavior was unavailable: the repository has no test suite, so the evidence is the observed output of these runs.
